title: Jittered sampling march costs ~6 s/frame at 1000^2 on Dozen and loses the device at 2000^2 (base too)
body: MEASURED (op-taarunner, Dozen, correctness-only): with VIXEN_LOOKDEV_JITTER_PROBE=1 the esvo_traverse_shade pass is 5.8-6.6 s per frame at 1000x1000 (VIXEN_PERF_CSV, frames 5-16) and the capture loses the device (VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST or SIGSEGV at frame 0) at 2000x2000. The base tree ea3edf08 (taa not compiled) fails the same way at 2000x2000, so it predates the TAA. Canonical (unjittered) captures at 2000x2000 complete. Blocks the 2000 TAA witness on Dozen. Tier sol: root cause unmeasured (reconstruction-input writes, jitter, or Dozen TDR); needs native timing. Evidence: /home/liory/codeman-cases/undertow/reports/taarunner-evidence/ (base-jit-midday-2000.log, jitnone-midday-2000.log, perf/taa-1000.csv).

title: With taa selected the reconstruction history seed still copies scene radiance into history A/B every frame
body: op-taarunner: selecting taa turns on reconstruction inputs, which instantiates ReconstructionHistoryModule and its seed pass (reconstruction_history_seed, about 0.03 ms on Dozen at 1000^2). The TAA keeps its own history (the runner-allocated ResolvedRadiance pair), so two viewport history mechanisms run. ReconstructionHistory.h says a temporal provider replaces the seed with its own history write. Conversion: the TAA's ResolvedRadiance pair becomes the viewport history (reset and camera-cut from ReconstructionHistoryState), or the host skips the seed when an AA provider owns history. Tier luna: several files and a capture witness.

title: DescriptorResourceGatherer compile check rejects a VkSampler on a SAMPLER binding
body: op-taarunner: CheckUsageCompatibility / IsResourceTypeCompatibleWithDescriptor accept VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_SAMPLER only for ResourceType::Buffer, so a VkSampler node output (SamplerNode) fails ValidateSingleInput at compile (FAILED: slot ... expectedType=0). The generated-system runner connects its sampler with the Execute role, which skips the compile-time check. Fix: map the VkSampler handle resource type to the SAMPLER descriptor, add a gatherer test, then drop the Execute role on the runner's sampler connection. Tier haiku: one compatibility rule plus a test.

title: Runner binds raw-index descriptors whose type reaches producers only after they compile
body: op-taarunner: a raw uint32 binding connects as a tentative slot with VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_MAX_ENUM; the gatherer learns the type from its shader at its own compile, after the image producer already derived its usage (DeriveImageUsage). The runner now states the manifest descriptor type for sampled views only (GeneratedSystemBinding), so the producer adds SAMPLED; storage bindings stay raw to keep the none graph unchanged. Conversion: pass the manifest's descriptor for every runner binding (and the SDI path's binding types already do this), then witness canonical byte identity. Tier haiku.

title: Runner orders a generated reader behind a hand chain by a declared flag, not by derived order
body: op-taarunner: ComputeStageNode has one ORDERING_WAIT_SEMAPHORE, so a generated system waits on one stage. With taa the tone map must follow both the TAA (manifest barrier) and the hand exposure chain (meter, reduce) that itself waits on the TAA. SchemaResourceRegistry::ProvideProducer(identity, stage, ordersAfterGeneratedWriters) lets the host declare that the hand producer already follows the generated writers. This is a hand declaration of transitive order (R394 smell). Removal: convert the exposure meter and reduce to generated systems (overlaps op-aataa's exposure-meter proposal), so the scheduler's barriers order the whole chain. Tier luna.
